title: How to Hear God’s Voice Every Day
titleZh: 每天如何聆聽神的聲音
summaryZh: 先知性是我們思考與看見的方式，能帶下神話語的啟示並真實改變周遭環境。
lines: Verse 29, and Moses said to them, "Are you zealous for my sake?"
第29節，摩西對他們說：「你為我的緣故嫉妒人嗎？」
Joshua the son of Nun, Moses' assistant, one of his choice men, answered and said, "Moses, my lord, forbid them."
摩西的幫手，嫩的兒子約書亞，就是摩西所揀選的一個人，說：「請我主摩西禁止他們。」
Moses said to him, "Are you zealous for my sake?"
摩西對他說：「你為我的緣故嫉妒人嗎？」
It's another way of saying, "It's not about me."
這也就是在說：「這不是關於我的事。」
"Well, they're crowding in on my gift."
It is that the Lord is represented well in powerfully anointed people.
而是神在那些大有恩膏的人身上，被美好地彰顯出來。
And whether it's your time to stand on the stage, or it's somebody else's...
無論現在是輪到你站在台上，還是輪到別人……
...or it's your moment to lay hands on the person, or you're the support person for somebody else...
……或者是輪到你為人按手，又或者你是別人的協助者……
...it doesn't matter as long as the function gets done.
……只要能發揮功用，這都不重要。
As long as the miracle takes place, as long as the breakthrough comes...
只要神蹟發生，只要突破來到……
...as long as God is exalted, the tools that He uses will always vary.
……只要神被高舉，祂所使用的器皿總是會不一樣的。
And we celebrate that God is being exalted through His means, not that we got to be at the center of the story.
我們慶祝的是神藉著祂的方式被高舉，而不是我們得以成為故事的中心。
Moses says, "Are you zealous for my sake?
摩西說：「你為我的緣故嫉妒人嗎？
Oh, that all the Lord's people were prophets and that the Lord would put His Spirit upon them!"
惟願耶和華的百姓都是先知，願耶和華把祂的靈降在他們身上！」
Here's something to recognize in the Old Testament.
在舊約中，有一點我們必須要認清。
Whenever you see somebody where the Spirit of God comes upon them...
每當你看到神的靈降在某人身上時……
...it is almost always, if not always, evident in them speaking the word of the Lord.
……他們幾乎總是——如果不是絕對總是——會明顯地宣告出神的話語。
先知性的恩賜會透過他們彰顯出來。
In other words, the sign of the fullness of the Spirit of God on a person's life in Old Testament context was prophecy.
換句話說，在舊約的背景下，神的靈充滿在一個人生命中的記號，就是說預言。
I think it's for that reason Paul, when he talks about the gifts of the Spirit, he says...
我想就是因為這個原因，當保羅談到聖靈的恩賜時，他說……
"Earnestly pursue all the gifts, but especially that you may prophesy."
「要切慕所有的恩賜，其中更要羨慕的，是作先知講道。」
If you were raised in church, you probably have a picture of the prophetic as that which happens during a meeting.
如果你是在教會長大的，你對「先知性」的印象，可能就是聚會中發生的那些事。
But I don't think that that's any more than 5% of the prophetic, and I think it's actually less than that.
但我認為那連先知性服事的百分之五都不到，而且我覺得實際上還更少。
The prophetic is a way that we function.
先知性是我們運作的方式。
It's a way that we think, it's a way that we see, it's the way that we communicate to people.
是我們思考的方式，是我們看事情的方式，也是我們與人溝通的方式。
It doesn't need to precede or end with, "Thus saith the Lord."
它不需要以「耶和華如此說」來開頭或結尾。
It is speaking a timely word in a given situation.
它是在特定的情況下，說出合時宜的話語。
And if the word is from Him, it will bear fruit in their life, and they in turn will give God the glory.
如果這話語是出於神，就會在他們的生命中結出果子，而他們也自然會將榮耀歸給神。
It doesn't have to come with religious trappings; it just needs to be released.
它不一定要帶有宗教色彩的包裝；它只需要被釋放出來。
When we release the word of the Lord, it alters and changes environments.
當我們釋放神的話語時，它會改變並轉化周遭的環境。
And we are in a season where we need desperately prophetic people to bring clarity to what's happening in the world.
我們正處在一個迫切需要先知性器皿的季節，好為世界上正在發生的事情帶來清晰的看見。
We need it desperately because both the political spirit and religious spirit are vying for your affections.
我們迫切需要它，因為政治的靈和宗教的靈都在爭奪你的心。
And whenever there's influence from either of those two realms, the word of the Lord becomes diluted and distorted.
而每當受到這兩個領域其中之一的影響時，神的話語就會被稀釋和扭曲。
And the Lord is wanting a clear word, a precise word, an empowering word to come to the cities and to the nations of the world.
神正渴望有一個清晰的話語、一個精準的話語、一個賦予能力的話語，臨到世界各個城市與列國。
We are being lied to every day of our life, every day of our life.
在我們生活中的每一天，我們都在被謊言蒙蔽，每一天都是如此。
If you have anything to do in media, you're being fed a bill of goods every day of your life.
如果你接觸任何媒體，你每天都被灌輸著虛假的資訊。
feed someone a bill of goods
But very little of it is intentional deception; most of it is agenda-driven.
但這其中很少是蓄意的欺騙，大多是出於背後的特定目的。
And when you're driven by an agenda that's wrong, you reinterpret circumstances incorrectly.
而當你被錯誤的目的驅使時，你就會錯誤地重新解讀周遭的環境。
